The online submission was made by Babu Selvam (9000000442). A further person, Murugan Sundaram, a driver, using the number 9000000207, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complaint mentions Janani Devi, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000454, in connection with the events. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots and CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00150, as the mobile number 9000000454 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
